oneOf.description: Refuse the start and say which files do not fit.

OutputTarget.description:
The canvases `record.start`, `record.stop`, `stream.start` and `stream.stop` act on:
one canvas, or every canvas the studio runs, main first (`all`, protocol 1.42,
ADR-0111 decision 3).

oneOf.description: The studio's main canvas.
The vertical canvas.
Every canvas the studio runs, main first (protocol 1.42).

acknowledge_heavy.description:
The caller accepts a `heavy` plan (protocol 1.54, ADR-0087 decision 6). Absent
or `null` is `false`; with this or `on_hardware_limit` set, the start gate may
refuse the start.

canvas.description:
The canvas to record; the main one when absent or `null` (protocol 1.29);
`all` records every canvas, main first (protocol 1.42).

iso.description:
Write the separate files of the marked sources (protocol 1.46, ADR-0086); only
the main canvas's recording has them. Absent or `null` follows Settings,
Recording, Separate files (`separate_files.enabled`, ADR-0164 decision 3).

on_hardware_limit.description:
What to do with separate video files past their encoder's capacity (protocol
1.54). Absent or `null` uses the profile's `recording.iso.on_hardware_limit`.

profile.description: A recording profile's id (`output.profiles`). The file goes into its folder.

calibrate.description:
The row is unknown and *Test this computer* can measure what is missing
(protocol 1.57); false on known and informational rows. Absent from older
servers, read as false.

level.description: The level; absent on informational rows (`memory`, `active_sources`).

limit.description: The limit, `None` when unknown or unlimited (`level` says which).

measured.description: The limit was measured on this computer (`calibration.toml`), not declared.

need.description: What the plan needs, in `unit`. Count units and bytes are whole numbers.

scope.description:
The adapter id for `encoder_sessions` and `encoder_throughput`; `video` or
`audio` for `iso_ceiling`; absent otherwise.

EstimateTrack.description: A separate track named by the estimate: its source and what it carries.

EstimateUnit.description: The unit of a resource row (protocol 1.53).

oneOf.description: Encoder sessions.
Pixels per second.
A share of one (a worker's time, the render budget).
Bytes per second.
Bytes.
Separate tracks.
Sources.
A unit this client does not know (a later minor).

MaxTracks.description: How many separate tracks of one kind fit (protocol 1.53, ADR-0087 decision 3).

at_most_now.description:
Video only: the most separate video files a start with these settings opens
now, however many are marked (while the encoder's capacity is unknown, at
most 3, or `known_count` when a measurement reached further). Absent without
a picture file template.

count.description: The total that fits; `None` when no resource that grows with them is known.

known_count.description:
The largest total at which the encoder capacity rows (`encoder_sessions`,
`cpu_load`) were known at every step (protocol 1.55); absent when none was.

limit.description: The resource that stops the count.

partial.description: Some growing resource is unknown: `count` is an upper bound.

unknown.description: The growing resources whose limit is unknown.

cost.description:
What it adds per resource, keyed by resource name. A client skips a key it
does not know.

oneOf.description: The source's picture as a video file (written from 1.52).
The source's sound.
A still source's picture as PNG images (protocol 1.52, ADR-0117).
A role this client does not know (a later minor).

gate_level.description: The level a start's gate judges: the same without the disk space row.

level.description: The plan's level (`fits`, `heavy` or `over`), free disk space included.

reasons.description: Coded reasons, for clients to localise.

tracks.description: What each separate video and sound file of the plan adds.

unknown.description: The resources whose limit is unknown.

ADR-0052 decision 4); `data.reason` says why.
